page.layout: One printed page. Woodcut ornament band above the title; title in capitals across the top; below it one column of numbered entries with page references at the right; signature at the bottom right.

main_text.head: SYLLABUS OPUSCU-LORUM HOC VOLUMI-ne contentorum.
main_text.l: I. Breve COLLOQUIVM IESUITICUM, toti orbi
Christiano, ad rectè cognoscendam, hactenus non satis
perspectam Iesuitarum religionem, utilissimum: habi-tum à S. Theol. D. PAVLO FLORENIO, cum
CHRISTIANO FRANCKEN Philosophiæ pro-fessore in Cæsareo Iesuitarum Gymnasio Vienna, anno
1578. 20. Ianuar. pag.1.
II. CHARACTERES IESVITARVM, pag.37.
Centuria I. pag.47.
Centuria II. pag.67.
Centuria III. pag.95.
Centuria IV. pag.124.
III. De studiis IESVITARVM abstrusioribus, & consiliis
eorum sanguinariis. pag.152.
IV. Quastiones Diabolo proposita à P. COTTONO Soc.
Iesu. pag.170.
V. CONSILIVM datum amico, de recuperanda & in po-
sterum stabilienda pace regni Polonia, in quo demon-
stratur, Pacem nec constitui, nec stabiliri posse, quamdiu
IESVITÆ in Polonia manent. pag.181.
VI. Exemplar LITTERARVM BONONIÆ datarum,
in quibus Excellentia & perfectio PATRVM SOCI-
ETATIS IESV ostenditur: multaque simul ipsis Pa-
tribus & eorum institutis facta obiectiones refoluûntur. pag.258.

page.notes: The woodcut band at the top and the library stamp at the lower left are not transcribed. "Quastiones": the first letters are a ligature, so the æ is uncertain. "refoluûntur": the scan shows a doubled u-mark; it may be a printing error. The small marks in the left margin are show-through and are left out.
